policies.name: Users can insert own bill line items
policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bills
  WHERE ((bills.id = bill_line_items.bill_id) AND (bills.user_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1

  WHERE ((bills.id = bill_line_items.bill_id) AND (bills.user_id = auth.uid()))))
